Item (k) passes. The first amended joint fit, A1, converges with three
coordinates on arbitrary bounds, which triggers the required return to Design.
No representative endpoint is selected and neither variant has a transfer
pass/fail verdict. These results have not been independently reviewed or
promoted for manuscript use.

## Kim-only pre-fit and amended starts

The ion-free MDEA–water calculation fits all 61 Kim 2008 Table 8 bubble
pressures, including the pure-water rows, using log-ratio residuals with
weight one. Vapor mole fractions do not enter the objective. The law is
$k(T)=k(313.15\,\mathrm{K})+b(1/T-1/313.15\,\mathrm{K})$.

| Initialization | k(313.15 K) endpoint | b endpoint (K) | Termination |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| −0.184, 0 K, primary | −0.181786994679 | −75.539233386 | Function tolerance |
| −0.15, 0 K | −0.181787002961 | −75.539241989 | Gradient tolerance |

Both endpoints converge within the owner's agreement limits of 1e−4 in k
and 1 K in slope. The primary scaled-Jacobian singular values are
0.2124813 and 0.02886988, with coordinate scales 0.01 and 10 K and no active
bounds. Cost is 0.0012265413 and pressure AARD is 0.4998313%. The initial
zero-pair attempt was refused for local liquid instability before iteration.
The two subsequent initializations were orchestrator choices from diagnosis
probes, not source values.

![Kim Table 8 observations and the Kim-only fit at the reported temperatures. Error bars show the source's 0.3 kPa pressure uncertainty; this uncertainty is not an objective weight. Predictions are discrete cross markers.](results/kim-prefit/bubble-pressure.png)

All four Gibbs-mixing convex hulls are miscible at 293.15, 313.15, 353.15 and
393.15 K. The 1,177 tangent-plane searches cover every Kim state and 279
compositions per grid temperature, including pure endpoints, at the diagnosis
pressure of 101325 Pa. All searches complete with zero unresolved trials and
zero liquid–liquid descent witnesses. This finite grid/search does not prove
global stability at every continuous composition.

The 170 vapor witnesses are retained separately. The owner confirmed that
the gate tests liquid miscibility. All 38 Kim states with vapor witnesses
have the matching positive bubble-pressure residual, with zero sign
mismatches. Near pure water at 393.15 K and atmospheric pressure, vapor
formation is expected; it is not liquid demixing.

All ten amended Carson searches pass: A1, A3, A4, B1 and B3 at rows 1 and
10, 298.15 K and the declared 101325 Pa convention. They complete with
zero unresolved trials and no descending split. Every start takes the primary
Kim pair. A1/B1 take ion–water k = −0.2298 with zero slope; A2/B2 are
recorded as duplicates, not separately run. A4 retains Bülow's ion sizes
and energy. These are starting-vector checks, not endpoint qualification.

[Fit, phase searches, sign checks and claim limits](results/kim-prefit/README.md)
and [amended documents and hashes](inputs/amended-starts/hashes.json) retain
the evidence. Kim source locators are Table 8, p.2524 and experimental
uncertainties, pp.2526–2527. Source provenance stays in the retained `data/reference/MDEA/stage1-sources.json`.

## Joint fit and mandatory stop

The first objective assembly was refused because the frozen R2 correlation
domain excluded six fitted rows. The refusal and original declaration remain
under `results/joint-fit/A1/`. The owner then authorized an application domain
upper bound of 395.0 K without coefficient changes, and moved the four
20/40 wt% Merkley markers at 288.71 and 422.04 K out of the fit. They remain
extrapolation comparisons and are unevaluated here. The fitted Merkley set is
four markers at 333.15 and 388.71 K. This amendment preserves the two nominal
393 K Kuranov rows and the full 88-row Ermatchkov comparison set.

The owner fixed both Jakobsen ratio scales at 0.10 times the observed ratio,
within the source's stated 5–10% range. This is an orchestrator choice,
not a source value or MEA-record precedent. All decisions are retained in
[the decision record](inputs/item-k-owner-decisions.json).

The amended objective has 280 residuals. A1 converges after 19 iterations:
$C_0=3908.8461453$, $C=2478.0559570$. The initial scaled-Jacobian singular
values span 20.8979 to 0.00258663; endpoint values span 20.9721 to 0.0155412.
Both have numerical rank nine. The endpoint covariance status is
`active_bound`. Local rank alone does not establish identifiable physical
parameters, especially at active bounds; weak-direction refit profiles stop
with the mandatory bound condition.

The tied packing diameter is 5.71753973 Å and the Debye–Hückel diameter
equals σ. No bound is widened to retain this endpoint.

Outside-fit data were not evaluated. The 88-row Ermatchkov CO₂ partial-pressure
AARD is unavailable for both variants; neither passes nor fails the 24.2%
criterion on this evidence. Neumann sensitivity and bicarbonate–water versus
k(MDEA–CO₂) follow-up refits were not run after the mandatory stop. Corrected
Kamps remains excluded from the two-percentage-point follow-up criterion.
**No MDEA outcome falsifies the MEA bicarbonate value.** Xiao and Zhang stay
unscored. No absorber-use or manuscript claim follows from this calibration.

## Endpoint replay and Carson phase evidence

All 280 predictions replay independently within maximum relative difference
2.2113e−12, below the 1e−8 requirement. At Carson row 1 the endpoint search
has no descent witness and zero unresolved trials. At row 10, loading
0.24797645, the endpoint has minimum tangent-plane distance /RT = −0.09140461
and an admitted split ΔG/RT = −0.04135485, compared with estimated numerical
error /RT = 2.6017e−8. Single-liquid closure residuals are at most 3.41e−13;
the row-10 split is a phase-assumption failure at a converged endpoint.

The bounds already required stopping; this independent phase search supplies
a second reason to return to Design. It does not establish experimental
liquid demixing. The retained [replay](results/joint-fit/A1/replay.json) and
[full Carson search](results/joint-fit/A1/carson-phase.json) own the quantities,
feasibility checks and numerical error estimates. Wider endpoint phase maps,
weak-direction refits, further starts and comparison states were not run
after the mandatory stop.

## Provenance and limitations

The shared MEA record remains SHA-256
`00e77608a8489fc9e03a7d2a86c08cb5ff782bb441368a62fa6390b8bfe9cc91`.
Engine commit 3e83e19c is used only through the immutable wheel SHA-256
`0d08dff9be39fb8fc9018119c47612f53d823cd0e456914d7dd44c6941596804`,
with installed files checked byte-for-byte. Calculations use the main
interpreter with `-I`, nice level 10 and one BLAS thread per process; worker
counts are sized from free memory and the full CPU count. No Engine source
is imported and no worktree environment is created.

The MDEA dissociation law above 368 K, the 2 K upper-domain extension and
the MDEA dielectric law above 328.15 K are extrapolation assumptions.
Conditional transfer, not universal ion parameters or process qualification,
is the intended scientific question. The bound-stopped endpoint does not
answer it. The main checkout, MEA record, manuscript and Zotero are unchanged.
Independent delivered review remains open.

Native presentation refresh was attempted inside this worktree only. It
failed because the `snakemake` executable is unavailable. The site section
index is updated; notebook HTML was not regenerated.
